verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from several ipindia.gov.in guidance pages, including /basics-of-patents, the e-services page and the Forms & Official Fees page. That suggests the public reading surface returned readable HTML rather than a JS-only shell or challenge page, and the llms.txt probe also got an ordinary HTTP 404 rather than a bot wall. However, nothing explicitly records a keyless fetch with an identified user agent or confirms the absence of WAF/CAPTCHA challenges. Missing for 10: an explicit probe showing HTTP 200 with a standard identified agent UA, confirmation of no bot wall or CAPTCHA across the guidance pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
